## Question and change

What problem or scientific question does this address? Describe the resulting change.

## Evidence and verification

Give the source version, configuration and run IDs relevant to any changed finding. State what you checked and what the comparison shows. For documentation-only changes, explain how the wording was checked against the evidence.

## Scope and limitations

Identify any changed interpretation, remaining uncertainty or effect on reproduction. Keep inherited findings distinct from the new contribution and retain attribution and applicable licenses.
